E7-2.claim: every run, BL2's sub-runs included: invariant_failures empty and gpu_only_lease_slots 0

E7-4.claim: accounting identity: total - overflow = own_capacity_usd(inst) for every run, and BL0a's total-accounting cost = BL0a + own capacity (1e-9 relative)

E7-6.claim: the allowance rule (M36): every A8 run outside the allowance sweep records B0_rule '0.1*BL0a', B0 = 0.1 x e6.bl0a_all of its own instance (1e-12 relative), resolved gamma 1 and kappa null; the sweep's runs record their own rule ('auto, kappa 10' with kappa 10, or the share of BL0a with kappa null)

E7-7.claim: the allowance sweep's runs at B0 = 10% of BL0a reproduce the main grid's Sublet runs at alignment 1 under L-tr and the stress block's Sublet runs, seed by seed (totals equal to 1e-9 USD)

E7-11.claim: abort shares and first-abort slots of the A8 rows in every grid; under the sweep's theory default, the share of runs that abort at slot 1 or earlier (informative)
